summary.note: refits share most of their training data: this describes stability and is not a test
summary.sentence: In every yearly refit, every tier-3 league needed a higher domestic rate than every tier-1 league.

bin_sentences: When two candidates' forecasts differed by 0 to 1 EFF/36, the higher-forecast player turned out better in 54.5% of pairs.
When two candidates' forecasts differed by 1 to 2 EFF/36, the higher-forecast player turned out better in 63.0% of pairs.
When two candidates' forecasts differed by 2 to 3 EFF/36, the higher-forecast player turned out better in 70.9% of pairs.
When two candidates' forecasts differed by 3 to 4 EFF/36, the higher-forecast player turned out better in 78.0% of pairs.
When two candidates' forecasts differed by 4 to 6 EFF/36, the higher-forecast player turned out better in 85.1% of pairs.
When two candidates' forecasts differed by 6 EFF/36 or more, the higher-forecast player turned out better in 93.3% of pairs.

coin_flip_below_1.sentence: Even forecast gaps below 1 EFF/36 were right more often than a coin flip (54.5%).

0.60.sentence: Forecast gaps of at least 1 EFF/36 were right at least 60% of the time.

0.70.sentence: Forecast gaps of at least 3 EFF/36 were right at least 70% of the time.
